lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Circular high-luminance blobs arranged in a semi-regular grid of approximately five vertical columns and four horizontal rows posterior to the gill slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that intersect with horizontal rows of spots, creating a distinct lattice-like appearance on the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear ridge along the upper flank characterized by a sharp luminance transition between the dorsal and lateral regions.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of at least two elongated dark-pixel clusters, consistent with remoras, attached to the ventral-lateral area below the pectoral fin.
